meta.question: How did the business do in Q3, and where should we focus in Q4?
meta.title: Quarterly business review: Q3 2026
meta.author: Finance and operations
meta.footer: Example quarterly review. All figures are illustrative.

answer.headline: Q3 revenue grew 14% to £1.82m, led by subscriptions; Q4 focus is reducing churn in the Starter plan, which is now our only shrinking segment.
answer.text: Subscriptions passed services as our largest revenue line for the first time. Costs grew more slowly than revenue, so margin improved, but Starter churn rose for the second quarter running.
points: Revenue £1.82m, up 14% on Q2 and 31% on Q3 2025
Gross margin 64%, up 3 points as hosting costs fell
Starter churn 4.1% a month, up from 3.2%: the main risk for Q4

blocks.label: About these numbers
blocks.body: Figures are unaudited management accounts at 30/09/2026. Churn is the share of customers on a plan at the start of the month who cancelled during it.
